question: Can a baryon-only field law with one universal setting remain competitive with full-field MOND on genuinely new resolved dwarf galaxies while closing most of the raw cluster-lensing gap to per-cluster compact-halo fits and obeying Solar-System bounds?

target_selection_inputs: absence from the preserved project baseline
forbidden_selection_inputs: performance of any new transport candidate on a selected target
selection_boundary.universal_parameter_rule: Every gravity or transport parameter must be one shared value frozen before any sealed target observable is parsed.
allowed_object_nuisance: one source-plane position per strong-lensing family, optimized identically for every comparator
forbidden_object_nuisance: dynamically refit stellar mass-to-light ratio in the primary score
velocity-refit distance or inclination in the primary score
per-cluster external shear in the primary score
per-object transport amplitude, scale, exponent, phase, or screening threshold

sealed_data_policy.commissioning_reason: DDO154 is already project-spent and may be used to debug the 2D ingestion and field-projection pipeline.
open_before_candidate_lock: WCS, beam, noise, distance, and photometric-orientation metadata
X-ray surface-brightness products used only to construct a baryonic gas model
sealed_until_candidate_lock: HI data cubes when spectral channels are exposed to fitting
strong-lensing image coordinates, family identities, and image multiplicities
published convergence, deflection, magnification, and critical-curve maps
candidate_lock_requires: a complete universal parameter vector and SHA-256 hash
passing Newtonian, AQUAL, and QUMOND solver gates
a prediction manifest for every selected system
a statement that no P0633 target outcome was used to choose the equation or parameters
sealed_data_policy.after_unlock_rule: Any formula change after a target score is seen is exploratory and cannot be called validation on P0633.

galaxy_validation.selection_rule: Use every Iorio et al. 2017 3D-kinematic galaxy absent from SPARC and absent from the baseline tree, except WLM, whose token already occurred incidentally in baseline metadata.
baryonic_inputs: optical or near-infrared stellar-light map with calibration
published distance and photometric orientation without velocity refitting
primary_metrics: noise-weighted 2D line-of-sight velocity-field RMSE in km/s

cluster_validation.selection_rule: Choose four RELICS clusters with public HST catalogs and at least two archived lens-model methods, spanning redshift and morphology, with every canonical name and archive slug absent from the baseline tree.
baryonic_inputs: HST member-galaxy light with a single population-calibrated stellar mass-to-light prescription
BCG light treated with the same universal stellar-population prescription
public X-ray gas morphology and normalization with uncertainty propagation
intracluster light included only when independently measured

raw_constraint_readiness.failure_rule: A selected cluster that lacks these constraints is a recorded data-readiness failure and may not be silently replaced after any selected target is scored.

family_split.method: Sort secure family IDs by SHA-256(salt|cluster_id|family_id); allocate the first ceiling(0.30*N) families to holdout and all remaining families to source-position fitting.
family_split.family_integrity: Every image from a family stays in the same partition.

primary_metrics: heldout family multiplicity and bright-extra-image topology

cluster: baryon-only GR using the same baryonic map
AQUAL/QUMOND potential used phenomenologically for photons and labeled non-relativistic
per-cluster compact-halo GR fit with parameter count reported

rejection_thresholds.prerequisite: Every field-solver acceptance gate must pass before a candidate can be evaluated on P0633 targets.
rejection_thresholds.overall: All prerequisite, galaxy, cluster, topology, universality, and Solar-System gates must pass independently; cross-domain averaging cannot rescue a failed gate.

acquisition.provenance_requirement: Record source URL, byte count, ETag or Last-Modified when available, and SHA-256 for every file.

claim_boundary: Passing would establish external empirical transfer for a phenomenological field law, not a complete relativistic theory.
AQUAL and QUMOND are non-relativistic; using their potentials for photons is a labeled diagnostic until a metric completion is derived.
Published lens models are comparator products, not raw observations, and cannot be used as baryonic input.
Failure on any locked gate is retained as evidence and the P0633 sample becomes project-spent immediately after unsealing.
